title: Understanding True Manhood
paragraphs: So, I want to talk about why men suffer from an identity crisis. It's about their lack of understanding of their talent. Every human being is born on this earth with a talent, and it is up to him to discover and refine it in order to achieve his potential. When a man, in particular, struggles with the identity he was born with, and what his talent is, it affects the woman. So, I'm talking about understanding true masculinity. Please write this phrase: You were born male, but you must become a man.

Being male or female is a biological fact; you did not choose it. But choosing to become a woman or a man is a personal choice, but it is linked to some fundamental issues. This leads me to the second point. Write this: What is masculinity? The average man struggles with this question. What does it mean to be a man, a real man? What is true manhood? Another question that concerns us as men is: What makes a man a man? What makes him a real man? Why is masculinity important for women?

As you know, when men don't know who they are, women are in a bind. Masculinity is not defined by the roles you play. The essence of a man's masculinity is his work. Everyone says work. The essence of a man's masculinity is his work. A man's work defines his identity. Let me say something about work. If a man is not happy with his job, he will not be happy with his home. Work is more important for men than for women. If a man is not working, he feels lost, becomes disappointed, and becomes confused.

God created man for work before He created woman for him. Work is mentioned in the Bible in Genesis, chapter 2, verse 15. Woman is mentioned in chapter 2, verse 24. God did not create woman to teach man how to work. Therefore, what a man really needs most is not a woman, but work. A woman cannot make you a man; work is what makes a man. This is wonderful. Listen to me carefully. God created man, then gave him work. Then he said, "It is not good for this man to be alone.

I will make him a suitable helper for his needs." What is it for? At work. Women were created to work, but they were created to work with men. If a woman was created for the purpose of work, but her work is to work with a man, and the man does not find work, then when a woman appears in his life, he will face two problems: she does not come to help him with anything. Let 's read Genesis 2:15. Here's what it says. The Lord God took Adam, whom He had created, and placed him in the Garden of Eden.

First, he ordered him to work. Then he plants. And may He protect and preserve it. Then the Lord commanded Adam not to touch the tree. These are all the instructions that God gave to the man in this single sentence. Work, look at the list. He says: Work, plant, protect, teach. Work, plant, protect, teach. The word Eden is the place where God put him. Work is what God has commanded. Therefore, Eden is an atmosphere of God's presence. The work is what God has assigned him in that presence.

Then God said: " I will give him a wife to help him." As you know, nothing is more beautiful in my eyes than seeing a man who has found his job and has a woman in his life who helps him do it. It's the most beautiful picture. I have a hidden joy in my heart. A hidden joy. And I am very happy. Please, I don't mean to criticize anyone just for being here or anything like that, but I think he is a great example. Look at my son Ken there, Christian Massif. As you know, when I sing, I don't look at him, but at his wife.

I once saw them singing on stage, and she was holding her child in her arms. She was singing, and he was jumping and moving forward. But she was there. Beautiful view. She sings, and she helps him with his work, even with the child present. This is the strongest aspect of his service, not his songs, but when people see that image. the job. Good. What is work? The first commandment that God gave to man is to work. I was shocked when I discovered its meaning, and I shared it with the men yesterday.

I just want to show you how you find your work today, then we will go back to our homes. The word "work" means to become. I thought it meant to do something. But the word that God uses is a different word that we don't think about. It means to become. It also means to show yourself. The word "work" in Hebrew is also defined as revealing yourself. When God took Adam and put him in Paradise, He said to him, "Reveal yourself." This is the job. In other words, work means getting your job done.

Let me see what's inside you. Show the world what you have hidden within yourself. This is the job. Work means becoming yourself. In other words, work means doing your job. When a bird flies, God calls that an act. When a fish swims, God calls that work. When it becomes a tree seed, God calls that work. Let me ask you a question then. If a bird is born to fly and begins to fly, and this is called work, do you think the bird enjoys its work? certainly.

In other words, when you are working, you are at the highest level of achievement. the job. The man was ordered to work, which means he was ordered to become himself. Let me suggest another idea to you. I know you're typing, but hurry up. Every human being is created with a valuable talent. I am reviewing this for the men who were not present yesterday, because I want to show you how to find this talent. Each one of you, male or female, was created by God with a valuable talent.

This is the area where you should excel in this aspect of talent. Your happiness lies in this talent. Therefore, the man was given, first and foremost, a talent. You can never lose your talent. The Bible says that God's call cannot be refused. Repeat after me: God's call is never rejected. In other words, if God gives you something to do, He will never take it away from you. Even if you misuse it. If you use your musical talent to sing nonsense, God allows you to keep it.

Here's the crux of the matter: Whatever talent God has instilled in you to come into this world and display, you still possess it now. Even if you've never used it before. Why is this important? Because you did not come to this land with a job or a career. That's why they can fire you from your job, take it away from you, or end your career by closing the company or letting you go. But they cannot take away your talent. The Bible never said that your education or job would determine your place in the world.

Your talent is the source of your importance. Do you know what every man in this hall wants? He wants to be valued in the eyes of his wife or family. Do you know what men call that? Respect. A man's primary motivation is to be respected. To be respected means to be seen as an important and significant person. Okay, gentlemen, I'm going to tell you how to become respectable. Discover your talent. Because your talent gives meaning to the women in your lives. It gives them meaning.

It gives you meaning, but it gives them meaning too. Therefore, your talent is the source of your importance. What makes Tiger Woods important? Not his education. What makes it important? He has talent. What made Michael Jordan important? It wasn't about the school he attended, or even the identity of his parents. Rather, it was related to his talent. The power of talent. Write this down: Whatever God asks for, He provides. God will never ask you for what He has not put in you. This is the first rule.

I call these the basic principles of talent. Secondly, whatever God asks for, He provides. Third, whatever God expects, He grants. Seventh, whatever God decrees, He will provide. Eighth, everything that God calls for, He puts in you. These are important principles and facts. Sixth, birds were created to fly. Therefore, God created birds to fly. Birds don't go to flight school. Fish were created to swim. Therefore, you will not find a fish attending a swimming lesson. Swimming is an innate instinct in fish.

Seeds become trees, but you won't find a seed that goes to a conference to learn how to grow trees. It's innate. Here's the principle: Everything God created you to be is not outside of you, but inside of you. Let me tell you why this is important. You can take a seed and plant it in a bad economy, and it will still be a tree. Listen. When the hotel closes, the birds continue to fly over it. Do you understand what I'm talking about? No, you didn't understand. Are you sure you understand?

Look, when you realize that your future is not around you or in front of you, then you will feel at peace. Because God has placed your future where you know He cannot miss it. We are looking for him everywhere except where he is. When a person finds their talent, they will achieve success anywhere. Are you listening to me? You can't give up on talent. This is important for men, because you see when a man loses his job, he loses his mind. Why? Because he confused his job with his talent.

He confused his job with his work. You don't go to work. You go to a job. The job may or may not exist. You should ask God, what is my talent? Did you know that some of history's greatest entrepreneurs, such as Steve Jobs, the inventor of the laptop, or Bill Gates, the inventor of software, started their businesses in their homes? In his garage, the man built his first desktop computer. What do you do with your garage? Well, I'm waiting for the opportunity. The opportunity lies within you. Think, man.

As you know, God did not give Adam a table, a chair, a house, or even clothes. Why? God hid the tables in the trees. I wonder what is hidden around you, in your backyard. If your wife knows, and you are not yet married, men, listen carefully. If you have a woman in your life, marry her. If your wife knows that you will never be fired from your job, she will always be safe. How can you become immune to dismissal? Look for something you cannot be separated from. Your talent.

When I first read Bill Gates' story, I was shocked. Bill Gates used to work for IBM. Do you know that? Yes. IBM saw him as just an ordinary employee. Then he came up with the idea for the program. Do you remember the DOS pointer and its related videos? He was working at the time. Then he came up with another idea: "Let's take all those things related to the DOS system and put them behind the program and make it work with the click of a button." They said it would never work, so they fired him.

His talent was present at the heart of their factory. And now, they buy from him. I wonder what your talent is. Are you going to work tomorrow? Will you take a job? The place you go should utilize your talent, not just give you a salary. Is it evolving? Are you using your talents in your current position? Please write this down. The secret to success that I presented to the men yesterday, I want to present to you again this morning. The secret to success is, first and foremost, not to strive for success.

I have been repeating this for years, and I will never stop repeating it. It is extremely important. Secondly, the key to success is becoming a person of value. This is why you become successful on a human level. The higher your self- worth, the more successful you will be in life. So, stop trying to be successful and try to become valuable. Why? Please write this down. Write it all down. Money is attracted to value. Say it. If you want a lot of money, don't chase after it. Make yourself valuable.

Money will find you. Money is attracted to value. The more value you give to yourself in the world, the more the world will pay you. I asked people, "What do you do?" "I work in business." "I'm a lawyer." I said: "The second question is, what kind of lawyer are you?" Look, being a lawyer doesn't make you rich. It's best to be a lawyer of a special kind. If there are too many of them, look for another major. In other words, you have to keep simplifying yourself to become... let me tell you the word.

To become valuable, here's what you need. First, importance. Secondly, you need to excel. Third, you need authenticity. How original are you in what you do? If I opened a shoe store in the Bahamas, I would be a success, you know. I know how to become valuable. First, I'm not going to sell every shoe in the world. I might decide that I only sell shoes to nurses. I will become so immediately. Every nurse will come directly to my store. Sectrin. They will pass by your store, then they will come to my store. Why?

Because I became exceptional. I became unique. If you sell everything, you will go bankrupt. That is why most people in this room are still struggling to succeed, because they change jobs every 3 years, they change careers. We do n't know what you are. In fact, the last thing is important: specialization. If you want to become successful, your talent is what makes you so. Listen, have you ever seen a bird trying to imitate the sound of a cow?

And the next morning, the discussion began, you know, about the dog—I mean the bird that tries to bark like a dog. No, birds stay true to their nature. It flies. You will not find a bird trying to say, "Today I will try to swim." It remains in its natural state. I saw a picture one day, you know, I saw a picture of a bird. I was sitting in a hotel lobby, and I saw this large picture of this bird, this big bird. It's a real picture. A large cage in the lobby of this hotel in the Philippines.

This bird was a beautiful bird. The bird was there throughout the days we spent in that hotel. He didn't fly anywhere. The bird was flying around this cage. And it lands in the same place. He was flying around the cage. And it lands in the same place. I sat in the hallway for many days. I would go in and look at the bird. Wow! The Holy Spirit says: "Do you see that? That's how humans are." He said, " This cage is most of their work. They go into it every day.

They open the door for them, they go in, and then the cage is closed. Although they could fly anywhere in the world, they are confined to this small space. But look at the beauty of this bird. Even though it is confined to the cage, it can still fly. The cage doesn't take away the talent; it only limits it. I don't care where you work now, my friends. They might lay you off next month. It doesn't matter anymore after the economic crisis. They will never be able to take away your ability to fly.

Sometimes, the Lord takes the cage out of your hands because you don't want to leave. You know, Reverend Richard and I used to work for the government. They would set our hours and the value of our work. I remember we reached a point where we had to decide to dedicate ourselves to this vision because we could build this thing, and there is no limit to its size." We can build it. But man, there's the issue of safety, you know, you, you, oh, the cage. At least I know where the cage is. As you know.

I know that they will feed me a little rice in the cage from time to time. As you know, so we have this thing. Now, I'm not saying jobs are bad because sometimes a job is where you go to develop your talent until it's time to take off. For God's sake, don't get hovered too early. But if you are... the point I want you to understand is to know your talent. So, if they move the cage or put you out of it, instead of getting depressed and falling to the ground, fly higher.

Just say thank you very much to everyone for your time and then fly. In the name of Jesus. This is what a man needs. A man needs to provide security for his woman. If anything happens, my love, I'll make it good. Why? What I possess, my love, what you married, is within me, my love. You didn't get married, that's what I do. You will marry me as I am. Say Amen, everyone. I didn't marry my career because I might lose it. You have married a latent talent in your son. Yes, man.

As you know, sometimes we think you'll spend your time in the Bahamas in hotels. No, man, you had time to catch sponges and fish. It would be best if you started gathering my thoughts. Your talent might be fishing. They are trying to make you an IT specialist. What is your talent? You become successful when you develop your talent. Polishing. In the name of Jesus. Strong talent. The Bible says this in Proverbs, chapter 18, verse 16. Please read aloud. What does he say?

"A man's talent opens doors for him and leads him to the great and the kings." I told you that I would be leaving here in a few hours for South Africa. I will not go to a campaign with a million people, but I will go to the person who makes the decisions on their behalf. He doesn't invite me because he knows I'm a Pinetown bohemian who eats oysters and goujons, but rather because he wants me to have my talent. Let me tell you why talent is important. Listen to me.

Here's why: If you know you have a talent, and everyone knows it, you just haven't discovered it properly. But once you discover it, you will become very wary of being manipulated. Look, once you know your talent, no one will be able to manipulate you anymore. No one will threaten you if you have talent. They will not be able to threaten you. They won't say: I'm going to fire you. No, you will not be able to expel me.

You are fortunate to have me in this place and at this time to use my own talent on your behalf to help you develop. So, behave yourself and pay me an extra amount of money. Then you won't be able to threaten anyone. What I am saying now is very important. Look, your talent protects you from manipulation. Here's what I mean by that. When you are fully aware of your talent, you will know that people don't like you because of your personality. Okay, you can get that another day. This is very important.

Let me take them, let me take them, I have my child because I know how to say this. Okay, listen to me. Holy Spirit, help me. Okay, listen. 99% of the people around you every day don't like you. This matter has been settled. What they like is what you are. That's all. That's all. Man, let's be honest. You don't like Michael Jordan. You don't know this man in the world. But you love that talent he had. We used to close every Monday night when he was playing. No one can bother us. Everyone closes.

Yes, yes, yes, go, go, go, go, go, go. I mean, we were forced to close. Do you know him? Listen, you're not in love with your dentist. You are not fond of surgery. They have talent. Therefore, you need someone to perform surgery on you. Yes, listen, we're not here to fall in love with you, son. Just fix me. You come for their talent. So, when people applaud you, don't let it bother you. When they come and say, " Oh, you're very good, you have talent," don't trust them. They are talking about your talent.

They are not talking about you. It's your talent that they're talking about. So, don't take it personally. Do you get me? It protects you from manipulation. Because people will manipulate you and make you feel like you need their approval. But your talent protects you. Your talent will make you stand before kings. why not? Why does the king want you? He doesn't want you. He wants talent. When the man was discovered in Egypt, there was a crisis.

By the way, this is the greatest time in the world to develop your talent right now in the midst of the crisis. As you can see, when crises occur, the world looks for talent. I will repeat this. Please write this down. When crises occur, the world looks for talent. Pharaoh was in trouble. The economy was on the verge of collapse. He knew he was in trouble. He said, "Look, there's talent in prison." He doesn't know who Joseph is, nor his mother or father, nor anyone.

He said, "But I understand that this man could interpret dreams." He pursued the gift. What did it do for him? Read the verse. It led him to Pharaoh. Not only that, but it made him prime minister. It is a gift. Never confuse what you study in university with your gift. They are often not the same thing. Sometimes when you turn to God, you realize you studied the wrong major. Because He shows you your gift, and your gift wasn't what you studied. And so you wasted four years and fifty thousand dollars.

That's why the Bible says, "Many are the plans in the human heart, but the will of the Lord prevails over all things." This means that once you return to your purpose, you will realize that your gift surpasses my degree. My degree was a waste of time. Because it is your gift that opens the way for you, not your education. You were born with the seed of greatness within you, man. And your seed is your gift. Your gift is your leadership.

You were born to lead in your field of talent, and you have to discover your talent, which becomes your mission in life, and that's what a woman comes in to help you with. The reason so many women work alone and are preoccupied with their own affairs is that they often can't find a man who knows his project. Do you know what a woman really wants? She wants to help her man succeed. That's true. But most of the time, the man doesn't know what he wants to do. Or he doesn't do anything.

Or he has no interest in doing anything. He hasn't figured anything out yet. So the woman gets frustrated, and she has all these tools and all this talent, all this intelligence, all this wisdom, all these things she brings, and then she meets someone who doesn't know what to do. I want to show you a little verse, and then listen... I was in South Africa. Let me share a little verse with you. Open, if you like, to the book of Proverbs, chapter such-and-such. What do I want to read?

I just heard something in my voice. It says: Oh, Ecclesiastes, chapter 11. Some proverbs, some proverbs, Ecclesiastes, some psalms, proverbs, Ecclesiastes. Do Got it? Then look for the Psalms, and then keep reading until you find Ecclesiastes after Proverbs. Okay? We can look at chapter 11. Look at verse 6. By the way, I want everyone to listen to this because it's very important. I've seen people violate this verse and go bankrupt and ruin their families. Here's the verse. Does everyone understand it?

Ecclesiastes, chapter 11, verse 6. Sow your seed in the morning, and in the evening do not let your hands be idle, because you do not know which will prosper, this one or that one, or perhaps both will prosper equally. This verse saved me in my teenage years, and it still does today. Let me explain this verse to you. Sow your seed in the morning, that is, go to your work. And in the evening, do not let your hands be idle, that is, find something to do after you finish your work, start another job.

Do whatever you like. It says, "because you do not know which will prosper." God doesn't want you to have two jobs; He wants you to have one job. And your job. Do you understand? Do you understand? Do you grasp this? Please, please grasp this. This means you shouldn't leave your job before you feel secure in it. He said, " Do both." But I believe that this ministry was founded while Reverend Richard, Reverend Henry, and I were working in different places.

We only joined this full-time service after we were able to manage everything. Hmm. Hmm. Let me explain it another way. You start working after you leave your job. I'm talking to you, man. Look, your job determines how much you should earn. Your job determines how much you want to earn. What is the important seed for obtaining the seed to get this service's swab? Look, if you allow your job to become your only source of income, you're in trouble. Because if they take that away from you, you will collapse.

Solomon says: "Go in the morning and plant your seed, and in the evening continue working. You do not know which one will be successful for you." He says, "Or even both." Man, you have a wife and children. You can't try an idea and then quit a job that provides for your rent and expenses. Use the wisdom of the Bible, the word of God. He says that you have to combine them until one of them outweighs the other. You can't... I've met your family. I have this vision. Yes, you have a vision, but you need logic.

Oh, it's one. Okay, I have to go. Thank God. Anyway, thank you all for being with me today. I have to go. When I get back, we can figure out where the talent lies, and how to find it, okay? Close your holy books. Let's go home. Thank God. One. Father, we thank you for your word today. Bless your people. Let them find their talent. Amen.
